name: bias-atlas
//test: The glob is required: `node --test test/` treats a bare directory as a module path and discovers zero tests while exiting non-zero. The glob-pattern argument itself needs Node >=22, which is why engines says 22 and not 20.
//serve: Dev-only static server for dist/. The base prefix in the strip regex must stay in sync with `base` in site.config.json — duplicated deliberately to keep this a zero-dependency one-liner. Binds 127.0.0.1 only, and 404s any path resolving outside dist/.

scripts.serve: node build/build.mjs && node -e "import('node:http').then(async h=>{const{readFile}=await import('node:fs/promises');const{extname,resolve,sep}=await import('node:path');const T={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json','.txt':'text/plain; charset=utf-8','.png':'image/png','.woff2':'font/woff2','.xml':'application/xml','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};const ROOT=resolve('dist');h.createServer(async(q,s)=>{try{let p=decodeURI(q.url.split('?')[0]).replace(/^\/bias-atlas(?=\/|$)/,'')||'/';if(p.endsWith('/'))p+='index.html';const f=resolve(ROOT,'.'+p);if(f!==ROOT&&!f.startsWith(ROOT+sep))throw new Error('outside root');const b=await readFile(f);s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':T[extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(b)}catch{s.writeHead(404);s.end('404')}}).listen(8080,'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log('http://localhost:8080/bias-atlas/'))})"
